scenes.text: A private island of consciousness. Completely separate. Entirely alone. Somehow still offended that nobody understands me.
scenes.query: a solitary luminous island surrounded by an endless star-filled sea, mystical twilight, impossible horizon, reflective water

scenes.text: Very efficient. Build walls around myself, then complain that no one visits.
scenes.query: an enchanted stone wall building itself around an empty garden table while invitations drift outside

scenes.text: Maybe hell is not a furnace beneath the earth. Maybe hell is the moment I look at every other person and see only an intruder.
scenes.query: a cold subterranean hall where every distant doorway contains a defensive shadow, mystical blue fire, cathedral scale

scenes.text: A universe of locked doors, each one whispering, "Whatever is behind me cannot possibly belong to you."
scenes.query: an endless mystical corridor of locked antique doors under floating constellations, whispered light leaking through keyholes

scenes.text: In that kind of hell, even love feels suspicious. Kindness must be hiding an invoice.
scenes.query: a glowing heart-shaped gift beside an absurd celestial invoice on an altar, mystical candlelight, playful surrealism

scenes.text: But what if heaven is not somewhere I go? What if heaven begins when the walls become windows?
scenes.query: a stone wall transforming into tall glowing windows that open onto a celestial garden, mystical dawn, moving light

scenes.text: Not when I lose myself, but when I realize the self was never the prison.
scenes.query: an open transparent cage resting inside a calm human-shaped field of starlight, mystical atmosphere

scenes.text: The prison was the belief that everything outside my skin was foreign.
scenes.query: a mystical translucent skin-like membrane around a small room dissolving into a shared forest of light

scenes.text: Maybe consciousness is not a collection of candles scattered through the dark. Maybe it is one fire appearing through billions of separate flames.
scenes.query: thousands of candles across a dark sanctuary revealing one continuous river of fire beneath them, mystical golden reflections

scenes.text: Each flame has its own shape. Its own dance. Its own magnificent little opinion about the wind.
scenes.query: distinct enchanted flames dancing differently around one circular hearth as visible wind ribbons pass through

scenes.text: And no, this does not mean I must trust everyone, tolerate cruelty, or invite chaos over for dinner.
scenes.query: an elegant mystical dinner table with one empty chaotic place setting politely moved outside a protective circle of light

scenes.text: Apparently becoming spiritually awake does not require becoming spiritually gullible.
scenes.query: a luminous third eye beside a sturdy brass lock and a clearly closed garden gate, mystical realism

scenes.text: A door can close without turning the whole universe into an enemy.
scenes.query: one gently closed wooden door inside a peaceful celestial hallway with every other door glowing warmly

scenes.text: A boundary can say, "You may not enter," without saying, "You are not part of life."
scenes.query: a luminous garden boundary protecting young plants while its roots visibly join the forest beyond

scenes.text: That distinction might be the first window. Maybe every act of compassion is reality remembering itself.
scenes.query: the first glowing window appearing in a dark cosmic house as warm light spreads through connected rooms

scenes.text: Not because we become identical. A choir does not create harmony by forcing every voice onto the same note.
scenes.query: a mystical choir represented by different glowing tuning forks forming one visible harmonic wave

scenes.text: Heaven may be difference without exile. Connection without possession. Love without the demand to disappear inside someone else.
scenes.query: separate mystical floating islands connected by bridges of light while each garden keeps its distinct shape

scenes.text: So perhaps I am not trapped in a universe filled with strangers. Perhaps I am standing inside one immeasurable house, meeting consciousness through different windows.
scenes.query: an endless mystical house whose windows open onto different lives, eras, oceans, and stars, warm celestial interior

scenes.text: Some are bright. Some are broken. Some are closed because the room behind them is still healing.
scenes.query: three enchanted windows in one old wall: radiant, cracked with silver repair, and gently curtained

scenes.text: And maybe I am not alone. Maybe I have simply been talking to myself through unfamiliar faces.
scenes.query: many distinct faces reflected softly across the windows of one warm house at dawn, mystical but human, gentle final light
